commits.messageHeadline: Add failing test: cancelled appointment still gets a reminder (#1)
Remove pending reminders when an appointment is cancelled (#1)
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/omorsi45/medilink-a3 into d…
Skip reminders for appointments that are no longer booked (review on …
Add Five Whys RCA for incident #1 and two preventive process changes

reviews.body:
Review pass (self-review):
- The failing test from the first commit now passes, and CI went red then green on this PR, so the test really catches the bug.
- Problem I found: the fix only works if every cancel goes through `AppointmentBook.cancel()`. If anything else ever changes an appointment's status, `send_due()` would still send the reminder because it never looks at the appointment. Since this is the incident, I want a second guard: `send_due()` should skip a reminder whose appointment isn't booked.
Pushing a follow-up commit for that before merging.

Second review pass after the follow-up commits:
- `send_due()` guard has its own test (status changed without `cancel()`).
- RCA has symptom, immediate cause, contributing factors, underlying causes, 5 whys and 5 actions, no names.
- Template and workflow changes match actions 4 and 5.
- CI green. OK to merge.

reviews.body:
